method: Independent official-page opening during this research run; no software or model calls executed; repository statistics collected separately by lead.

claims.claim: MCP 2026-07-28 transport semantics differ from older session handshakes
claims.value: stdio and Streamable HTTP; client-to-server requests and per-request metadata; old initialize/session behavior is compatibility context

claims.claim: MCP authorization is optional at protocol level with transport-specific requirements when used
claims.value: HTTP SHOULD follow authorization spec; stdio SHOULD NOT use that OAuth flow and instead uses environment credentials

claims.claim: C# MCP SDK latest observed release includes security patch
claims.value: v2.3.1 Latest, 2026-11-03; authenticated stateful sessions security fix, not first product launch

claims.claim: C# SDK license summary must acknowledge transition
claims.value: New code/spec contributions Apache-2.0; unrelicensed older contributions retain MIT; non-spec documentation CC-BY-4.0

claims.claim: Inspector is a testing tool, not general production host or security sandbox
claims.value: Official current identity is deterministic MCP server testing tools; license contains MCP transition notice

claims.claim: Langfuse official observability SDK languages and .NET route
claims.value: Official Python v5 and JS/TS v6; .NET through OpenTelemetry and public API, not native full-parity Langfuse C# SDK
HTTP JSON/protobuf; gRPC not supported as observed; attributes and ingestion header require integration validation

claims.claim: Langfuse legacy endpoint retirement is scheduled future scope, not product discontinuation
claims.value: Cloud legacy trace/observation ingestion cutover 2026-11-16; score-create exception; self-host v4 and SDK compatibility are separate

claims.claim: Langfuse core MIT does not include every enterprise governance feature
claims.value: EE key required for server-side masking, retention policies, audit logs and project-level RBAC; redact before ingestion when these are absent
License includes restriction on offering substantial features to third parties as hosted/managed service; not blanket MIT/Apache

claims.claim: Microsoft eval components have different execution requirements
claims.value: NLP deterministic, Quality LLM judge, Safety uses Microsoft Foundry Evaluation service; RTC evaluator experimental
NuGet page displayed10.11.0 without preview suffix; does not establish stability for every evaluator
Apache-2.0; does not establish license of models or NIM products
Old semconv/gen-ai page is explicitly moved to a distinct official repository; not unmaintained OTel product
Enterprise plan required; SDK source license does not mean whole platform free self-host

claims.claim: Promptfoo local CLI does not imply absence of network activity
claims.value: Basic usage telemetry on by default, optional account identifiers when present; telemetry excludes prompts/outputs/test cases/API keys, per vendor

limits: No benchmarks, Hebrew evals, endpoint tests or package installations
Facts from distinct pages of same vendor are not independent third-party corroboration
